clips.label: Crowded continuation — rejected
clips.details:
Tries to clear the doorway and follow the train sideways. The generated train changes position, and the ending develops repeated shapes that obscure it. Preserved as a failed attempt, not a recommended film.

clips.label: Meadow revision
clips.note: Harp forest → meadow, with an obstructing wall
clips.details:
Rewinds to source second 22. Gentler motion, a temporary noise rise to 0.80 and descriptions of a spacious meadow open a new landscape. A large red wall or curtain still occupies much of the right side.

clips.label: Beyond the Threshold — revised film
clips.note: Whale railway → doorway → music forest → meadow
clips.details:
Branches before the clock dominates. Reframes and approaches the actual doorway, introduces a different world beyond it, then aims through a measured gap between the near harp and red wall toward the train and meadow. The opening matches the original through nine seconds; later passages have different timing and imagery, so this is an artistic revision rather than a controlled test of one setting.
